Today the job is three other rooms: About, Skills, and How It Works. And How It Works is a button that opens the School — eighteen pictures, three at a time across the page.

intelligence.naya_view: Approval and focus are two different rulings, and this call made both. The twelve elements are done — approved, authorized for their own address, icon on the main page, the end returning to the hub. That closes the chapters as work. But "done and approved" is not "work on this now" — the focus ruling says the opposite: About, Skills, and How It Works are where we are working, and the twelve elements are not. The open question inside the approval must stay open: he said the end goes back into the hub, while the round-2 build proves the end returns to the portal — until he confirms which he means, neither destination is treated as settled. And the button ruling settles a naming question that had been drifting: it is called "How It Works", and it opens the 18-image School build — the School of Naya IS the How It Works page content, one third, one third, one third.
